title: Frozen SWAP 4.3.1 Secondary Availability and Mass Attribution Inventory

frozen_pre_solver_limiter.management_period_resolution: calendar/day-dependent IMPER lookup inside drainflux_extended; modern D3 receives resolved interval control instead
frozen_pre_solver_limiter.allocation: multiply every secondary QDRAIN(level), including positive contributors, by QDRATIO
frozen_pre_solver_limiter.algebraic_observation: for SWST>=0, WSCAP>=0 and DT>0, a triggered limiter necessarily has QDRD<0 and mathematically gives 0<QDRATIO<1

supply_capacity_semantics.WLEVBAL_resolved_WSMAX: WSCAP only when WLSTARA > ZBOTDR(1+NRPRI)+1e-4; otherwise zero
supply_capacity_semantics.fixed_weir_reader_guard: for SWMAN=1 with WSCAP>1e-7, HBWEIR-WLDIP below the secondary bottom is rejected
supply_capacity_semantics.consequence: raw WSCAP and physically available supply capacity are not interchangeable for all source-admitted control routes

frozen_wlevbal_low_storage_branches.mass_consequence: if actual supply is WSMAX, setting SWST to zero leaves an unmatched residual of -SWSTMAX; for negative SWSTMAX this would require supply above WSMAX to close exactly

frozen_wlevbal_low_storage_branches.mass_interpretation: actual q_supply is WSMAX and balance can close exactly
actual q_supply is the exact rate needed to reach SWSTTARA, generally between zero and WSMAX, but is not exposed as first-class output

legacy_dry_floor_mass_gap.mass_conservation_disposition: not admissible as a physical mass tolerance in SWAP5
legacy_dry_floor_mass_gap.modern_rule: derive actual q_supply from the mass equation; if required q_supply exceeds resolved capacity, reject/recompose/retry rather than force storage to zero

explicit_modern_mass_terms.equation: S1-S0 = DT*(QDRD + QRapDra + q_supply - q_discharge) + RUNOTS
explicit_modern_mass_terms.QDRD: signed secondary drainage exchange total after any D3 limiter
explicit_modern_mass_terms.QRapDra: rapid macropore drainage into secondary water
explicit_modern_mass_terms.RUNOTS: signed top-surface amount over the interval, not a rate
explicit_modern_mass_terms.q_supply: must be explicit accepted external inflow result
explicit_modern_mass_terms.q_discharge: must be explicit accepted external outflow result
explicit_modern_mass_terms.WDIS: legacy local discharge scratch; cannot substitute for an accepted-ledger contract

mixed_sign_scaling_observation.source_behavior: one net-shortage ratio scales all secondary level fluxes
mixed_sign_scaling_observation.recommended_initial_candidate_restrictio: when limiter is active, require all secondary requested q_i <= 0 until mixed-sign scaling receives independent scientific disposition

pre_post_soil_composition.consequence: a pre-solver nonnegative envelope does not prove the final surface-water storage will remain nonnegative
pre_post_soil_composition.modern_requirement: D6 must perform final trial mass closure using all actual transfers before commit and retry/recompose if the storage floor or supply capacity would be violated

state_classification.SWST: committed conserved state owned by D1 storage component
state_classification.WSCAP: immutable/control parameter capacity, not actual mass flux
state_classification.resolved_q_supply_available: dynamic physical control input to limiter envelope
